artboards.title: Accessibility Spec — WCAG AA contrast audit, touch targets, dynamic type scaling

annotations.text: Prompt 55 — WCAG AA contrast audit. Heritage Gold FAILS on all light backgrounds (1.85-2.25:1). Terracotta borderline on Ivory White (4.33:1). Touch target min 44dp. Dynamic type capped per token. Indic line-height grows with scale step.
